title: 'the Crown' reputation line stayed frozen at 'unknown to Marrowgate' for all 593 turns, even though I explicitly swore to burn hollows for the Regent, was told '(the Crown +1)' twice in dialogue (Herald Corvane at Last Light; the Marrowgate envoy at Highward when the writ was granted), used the Regent's writ to cross Coldpass and Marrowgate's gate, and finished by burning the Hollow Throne itself — the single most Regent-aligned ending available. The label never once changed to reflect any of that.
